implementation.root_cause: The 35%/65% group-zone classifier compared raw clientX against fractional DOMRect boundaries. MouseEvent.clientX is quantized to an integer CSS-pixel boundary: a pointer intended for the 35% boundary was read at ratio 0.3494318181818182 and incorrectly classified as before rather than the contractually inclusive group zone. Preview and drop must use one classifier to avoid visual/action disagreement.
implementation.fix: The existing shared isDockGroupZone helper now applies a 0.5 CSS-pixel measurement tolerance at the inclusive group boundaries. Both dragover preview and drop commit use that same helper; the canvas and invalid-width exclusions remain unchanged.
implementation.reuse_and_license: Extended the existing first-party dock-zone classifier and Chromium regression fixture. No third-party code or runtime dependency was added.
